extraFacts.fact: Parker's SR series stainless-steel round-body air cylinder is rated for 250 psi air service; standard seals operate from -10°F to +165°F, about -23°C to +74°C. Nose, pivot and foot-type mountings are offered, and the stainless body is a non-repairable design.
extraFacts.source: Parker Pneumatic Division catalogue 0900P-7, Round Body Cylinders (SR / SRM series) (parker.com)

extraFacts.fact: In the SR series model code the first figure is the bore in inches (e.g. 1.50 for 1-1/2 inch) and the last figure is the stroke in inches (e.g. 04.00 for 4 inch); this matches the stroke in the size-table row for every SR, SRD, SRG, SRGM and SRM code listed.
extraFacts.source: Indus size tables (partNumber vs strokeIn) for the Parker SR family; Parker catalogue 0900P-7

extraFacts.fact: In the Indus Parker SRM listings the specification reads Features: Switch Ready, Body Material: Stainless Steel, End Cap Material: Aluminum and Cushion Type: None; the M suffix marks the switch-ready magnetic-piston version of the SR cylinder.
extraFacts.source: Indus listing specifications for Parker SRM Series Air Cylinders (1-1/16 and 1-1/2 inch bore)

extraFacts.fact: The Parker SRG listing describes a double-acting stainless steel pneumatic cylinder with a LipSeal piston, 303 stainless steel head and cap, aluminium piston, oil-impregnated bronze rod bushing and stainless steel piston rod, non-repairable, with 2 x 1/8 inch NPT ports and a 1/4-28 UNF male rod thread on the 3/4 inch bore, ambient -10°F to +165°F. The SRGM adds a piston magnet and lists ambient 14°F to 140°F, about -10°C to +60°C.
extraFacts.source: Indus listing specifications for Parker SRG Series (3/4 inch bore) and SRGM Series (1-1/16 and 3/4 inch bore) Air Cylinders

extraFacts.fact: 100 psi is about 6.9 bar and 250 psi is about 17 bar (1 bar = 14.5038 psi).

extraFacts.source: WCO Harmonized System Nomenclature 2022, heading 84.12, subheading 8412.31
